description: This file implements the TpmStorage class, which manages TPM (Trusted Platform Module) storage operations such as key existence checks, reading, writing, and key handle management, including secure index handling and TPM interactions.

classes.name: TpmStorage
classes.description: A class that manages TPM NV storage, including key handling, reading, writing, and index management.

methods.name: TpmStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TPM storage with a resource manager and index file.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the TPM storage index file exists and contains entries.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in TPM storage.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data associated with a key from TPM NV storage.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to TPM NV storage under a specific key.

methods.name: GenerateRandomHandle
methods.description: Generates a random handle for TPM NV space, falling back to software RNG if TPM randomness fails.

methods.name: GetHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the handle associated with a key from the index.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a new TPM NV space for a key with specified size.
